status: pilot — pre-sign-off, placeholder parameters; not a test of P4
units: money per second (engine price / PRICE_PRECISION); profits net of fees
notes: N counts snipers. With the BCS maker (fast, pays c) there are N + 1 racing firms.
Rent is marked per fill at V at execution (edge_pnl); sniper_gross_end_v is the accounting.decompose end-of-run V mark of the same quantity, noisier.
Identities checked per run: sum of edge P&L = 0, sum of gross P&L at end V = 0, sum of net P&L + exchange revenue = 0. Speed is outside them: all-in welfare = -speed.
Theory: analysis/bcs_theory.py; the fee, quote-size and elastic-investor mappings are derived here (see theory(), theory_half_spread_bp()). c > R/2 cells have no prediction.
PLACEHOLDER path parameters (config.path) until the DATA lane's calibration.
Book data has no latency: a sniper slower than the maker's cancel sends no IOC rather than a missing one; fills/P&L unaffected; IOC counts are not a cost basis.
